name: Pipelines
description:
The Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines API allows you to create, edit, delete, start, and view details about pipelines.

Spark Declarative Pipelines is a framework for building reliable, maintainable, and testable data processing pipelines. You define the transformations to perform on your data, and Spark Declarative Pipelines manages task orchestration, cluster management, monitoring, data quality, and error handling.

Instead of defining your data pipelines using a series of separate Apache Spark tasks, Spark Declarative Pipelines manages how your data is transformed based on a target schema you define for each processing step. You can also enforce data quality with Spark Declarative Pipelines expectations. Expectations allow you to define expected data quality and specify how to handle records that fail those expectations.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description:
Creates a new pipeline using Unity Catalog from a pipeline using Hive Metastore.
This method returns the ID of the newly created clone.
Additionally, this method starts an update for the newly created pipeline.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description:
Deletes a pipeline. If the pipeline publishes to Unity Catalog, pipeline deletion will cascade to
all pipeline tables. Please reach out to Databricks support for assistance to undo this action.

all_fields.name: cascade
all_fields.description:
If false, pipeline deletion will not cascade to its datasets (MVs, STs, Views).
By default, this parameter will be true and all tables will be deleted with the pipeline.

all_fields.name: force
all_fields.description:
If true, deletion will proceed even if resource cleanup fails.
By default, deletion will fail if resources cleanup is required but fails.

all_fields.name: filter
all_fields.description:
Criteria to select a subset of results, expressed using a SQL-like syntax.
The supported filters are:
1. level='INFO' (or WARN or ERROR)
2. level in ('INFO', 'WARN')
3. id='[event-id]'
4. timestamp > 'TIMESTAMP' (or >=,<,<=,=)

Composite expressions are supported, for example: level in ('ERROR', 'WARN')
AND timestamp> '2021-07-22T06:37:33.083Z'

all_fields.name: max_results
all_fields.description:
Max number of entries to return in a single page. The system may return
fewer than max_results events in a response, even if there are more events
available.

all_fields.name: order_by
all_fields.description:
A string indicating a sort order by timestamp for the results, for example, ["timestamp asc"].
The sort order can be ascending or descending. By default, events are returned
in descending order by timestamp.

all_fields.name: page_token
all_fields.description:
Page token returned by previous call. This field is mutually
exclusive with all fields in this request except max_results. An error is
returned if any fields other than max_results are set when this field is set.

all_fields.description: The pipeline to return events for.

required_positional_arguments.description: The pipeline to return events for.

poll_field.description:

exclusive with all fields in this request except max_results. An error is
returned if any fields other than max_results are set when this field is set.

methods.name: ListPipelines
methods.description: Lists pipelines defined in the Spark Declarative Pipelines system.

all_fields.name: filter
all_fields.description:
Select a subset of results based on the specified criteria.
The supported filters are:

* `notebook='<path>'` to select pipelines that reference the provided notebook path.
* `name LIKE '[pattern]'` to select pipelines with a name that matches pattern.
Wildcards are supported, for example: `name LIKE '%shopping%'`

Composite filters are not supported. This field is optional.

all_fields.name: max_results
all_fields.description:
The maximum number of entries to return in a single page. The system may
return fewer than max_results pipelines in a response, even if there are
more pipelines available. This field is optional. The default value is 25.
The maximum value is 100. An error is returned if the value of max_results
is greater than 100.

all_fields.name: order_by
all_fields.description:
A list of strings specifying the order of results.
The supported order_by field is id. The default is id asc.
This field is optional.

all_fields.name: page_token
all_fields.description: Page token returned by previous call

poll_field.description: Page token returned by previous call

methods.name: StartUpdate
methods.description: Starts a new update for the pipeline. If there is already an active update for the pipeline, the request will fail and the active update will remain running.

all_fields.name: development
all_fields.description:
Whether the update is started in the development mode.
This is recommended for interactive development and testing.
Reuses compute for faster iteration and disables automatic retries.
Not recommended for production.

all_fields.name: full_refresh
all_fields.description: If true, this update will reset all tables before running.

all_fields.name: full_refresh_selection
all_fields.description:
A list of tables to update with fullRefresh. If both refresh_selection and
full_refresh_selection are empty, this is a full graph update. Full Refresh on a table means
that the states of the table will be reset before the refresh.

all_fields.name: full_refresh_selection_by_path
all_fields.description: A list of file paths that identify the tables to update with a full refresh.

all_fields.name: parameters
all_fields.description: Key/value map of parameters to pass to the pipeline execution

all_fields.name: refresh_selection
all_fields.description:
A list of tables to update without fullRefresh. If both refresh_selection and
full_refresh_selection are empty, this is a full graph update. Full Refresh on a table means
that the states of the table will be reset before the refresh.

all_fields.name: refresh_selection_by_path
all_fields.description: A list of file paths that identify the tables to update.

all_fields.name: replace_where_overrides
all_fields.description:
A list of predicate overrides for replace_where flows in this update.
Only replace_where flows may be specified. Flows not listed use their original predicate.

all_fields.name: reset_checkpoint_selection
all_fields.description:
A list of flows for which this update should reset the streaming checkpoint. This selection will not clear
the data in the flow's target table. Flows in this list may also appear in refresh_selection and full_refresh_selection.

all_fields.name: rewind_spec
all_fields.description:
The information about the requested rewind operation.
If specified this is a rewind mode update.

all_fields.name: validate_only
all_fields.description: If true, this update only validates the correctness of pipeline source code but does not materialize or publish any datasets.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the pipeline by canceling the active update. If there is no active update for the pipeline, this request is a no-op.
